meta.title: A live RFQ: the "Analytics" tab opens
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on its Responses tab, which is the required starting state.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required withdrawal visibility setting.
Allow the live-event withdrawal behavior specified by the case.
Enable vendor masking for everyone as required.
Open the Analytics tab from the prepared live RFQ.
Assert that the Analytics screen opened.
Assert the expected analytics content for a live RFQ with no bids.
Assert that the analytics screen has no rendering, server, or page-crash errors.
